distribution_policy: Model binaries are excluded from Git source; the 0.7.0 Windows share release includes the five verified model files documented in licenses/V2_MODELS_NOTICE.txt. No user photographs or generated exports are distributed.

models.title: MediaPipe Face Landmarker
models.weights_license_note: Official model cards explicitly license these models under Apache-2.0. Official latest downloads match the pinned /1 SHA256. Evidence is archived in licenses/mediapipe/provenance.json.
models.activation: Explicit setup.ps1 -DownloadModels; no download during photo processing.
models.intended_use: Locate facial landmarks and derive protected facial regions; no face generation.

hash_evidence.verification_scope: Release validation only; the installer must verify each local download. Weights remain excluded from source distribution.

models.title: MediaPipe Selfie Multiclass Segmentation 256x256
models.weights_license_note: Official model cards explicitly license these models under Apache-2.0. Official latest downloads match the pinned /1 SHA256. Evidence is archived in licenses/mediapipe/provenance.json.
models.activation: Explicit setup.ps1 -DownloadModels; no download during photo processing.
models.intended_use: Estimate background, hair, body skin, face skin, clothes and accessory regions; not ground-truth labels.

hash_evidence.verification_scope: Release validation only; the installer must verify each local download. Weights remain excluded from source distribution.

models.title: IC-Light v1 foreground-conditioned relighting
models.weights_license_note: Integrated as an explicit opt-in JSON worker. The pinned base model also declares CreativeML OpenRAIL-M. MediaPipe foreground masks replace BRIA; no BRIA model is used. Full fixed revisions, files and checksums are in relight-manifest.json. Code licensing does not replace model-weight terms.
models.activation: Explicit download action only; generation requires local checksum-verified models and never downloads.
models.intended_use: Optional generative relighting experiments; no identity-preservation guarantee.

models.title: ModelScope Skin Retouching (V2 neural blemish repair and skin blend)
models.weights_license_note: Pinned source and two checkpoints; see licenses/modelscope/provenance.json and licenses/V2_MODELS_NOTICE.txt.
models.activation: Included and checksum-verified in the 0.7.0 full share release; source users must explicitly download models.
models.intended_use: Opt-in local repair and full-resolution tiled skin blending; no automatic selection of every candidate.

models.title: LBM Relighting (planned non-commercial research adapter)
models.weights_license_note: No code or weights vendored. SDXL base-model terms also apply; research/non-commercial restrictions are not changed by PortraitLab AGPL code.
models.activation: Disabled; no implementation and no automatic download.
models.intended_use: Optional single-step image harmonization research; not a validated natural portrait-retouching backend.
